page_title: LEC 0-0 SAS | Lecce v Sassuolo 18/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sassuolo.
90+5' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+5' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo) inside the box. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sassuolo.
90+3' The referee shows a yellow card to Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
90+3' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball. Sassuolo will take a free kick.
90+1' Lameck Banda (Lecce) brings his opponent down. Valerio Crezzini has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Sassuolo will take a free kick near the side line.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender.
89' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

89' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play and Lecce manage to earn a corner.
88' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
86' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Medon Berisha and he is replaced by Balthazar Pierret (Lecce).
86' It will be a substitution. Konan Ndri (Lecce) is ready to enter the pitch as Tete Morente walks off.
84' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Valerio Crezzini had an easy-decision to make.
83' Lecce have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
82' It must be a yellow card. It is. Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
80' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Valerio Crezzini blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Lecce.
78' Medon Berisha (Lecce) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
78' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick is awarded to Lecce.

76' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Arijanet Muric.
75' Sassuolo fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
74' Substitution. Santiago Pierotti makes his way off the pitch and Lameck Banda (Lecce) comes on as his replacement.
74' Fabio Grosso decides to make a substitution. Andrea Pinamonti will be replaced by Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fali Cande (Sassuolo) replaces Filippo Romagna.
73' A corner kick by Lecce is thwarted by the well prepared Arijanet Muric (Sassuolo).

72' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Tete Morente (Lecce), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
70' Medon Berisha (Lecce) cuts inside after a good run and goes for glory from the edge of the box. The shot, though, flies high over the bar into row Z.
69' The total number of attempts is 8:6. The shots on goal statistics – 1:2.
66' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
65' Referee Valerio Crezzini sees the trip by Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Lecce have a free kick.
64' The game has come to an end for Lassana Coulibaly. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce).
64' Here is a change. Nikola Stulic is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Francesco Camarda (Lecce).
64' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the right post.
63' Wladimiro Falcone pulls off a great save to deny Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
62' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Valerio Crezzini blows his whistle for an infringement. Lecce earn a free kick.
62' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
61' The game is interrupted now, Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
61' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
60' Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Lecce are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
59' It looks like Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) saw red with that tackle. Valerio Crezzini won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Sassuolo have been awarded a free kick.
57' Fabio Grosso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo) replacing Aster Vranckx.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicholas Pierini (Sassuolo) comes onto the pitch for Armand Lauriente.
54' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
53' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
53' Surely that's handball by one of the Sassuolo players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
52' The resulting corner from Medon Berisha (Lecce) is cleared by the defence.
50' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wladimiro Falcone, who smothers the ball.
49' Sassuolo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
49' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sassuolo.
47' Rough tackle by Medon Berisha (Lecce). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Sassuolo.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Valerio Crezzini couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) and blew his whistle. Lecce win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce). Sassuolo have a free kick.
42' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
41' Medon Berisha (Lecce) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
39' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
37' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the left post by a whisker.
35' Tete Morente (Lecce) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
34' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
33' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
32' Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Valerio Crezzini blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Lecce, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
32' The corner is swung in but Lecce can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
31' Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. Lecce get a corner.
31' Tete Morente (Lecce) will deliver the corner kick.
30' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Lecce will take a corner kick.
29' Tete Morente (Lecce) is penalised for a foul. Valerio Crezzini had a clear view and blows his whistle. A free kick to Sassuolo.

27' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
24' Filippo Romagna (Sassuolo) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
23' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

22' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise. Now Sassuolo have a corner.
22' That's unlucky! Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.

18' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the bottom left corner, but Wladimiro Falcone pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
17' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) was too forceful with his tackle and Valerio Crezzini interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Sassuolo have a free kick.
15' Flag up against Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

13' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score into the bottom right corner, but great anticipation by Arijanet Muric allowed him to make a comfortable save.
13' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) commits a foul and Valerio Crezzini immediately signals a free kick. Lecce are awarded the free kick.
12' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
11' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Sassuolo get a free kick.
10' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) tackles a bit over-zealously and Valerio Crezzini blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Sassuolo.
8' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. Sassuolo are awarded a free kick.
7' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
5' The foul by Danilo Veiga (Lecce) was seen by Valerio Crezzini who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Free kick. Sassuolo will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
4' My Gran could have done better! Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
3' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
1' The match has just started.
Sassuolo will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Valerio Crezzini.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
